output.summary: The California Department of Education is raising the most it can reimburse the district for the California State Preschool Program in 2021-22 by $632,001, from $12,544,193 to $13,176,194. The required minimum child days of enrollment rises from 234,866.0 to 237,709.0, and the maximum rate per child day rises from $53.41 to $55.43. Required days of operation stay at 240.

output.headline: Ratifies free use of district sites for Kaiser COVID-19 vaccination clinics
output.summary: Kaiser Foundation Health Plan and Kaiser Foundation Hospitals may use district facilities to run temporary COVID-19 vaccination clinics, on dates and times listed in an exhibit to the agreement. Neither side owes the other any fees, and each takes on certain operating tasks. It started August 3, 2021 and continues until the parties agree it is no longer needed.

vendor.name: Kaiser Foundation Health Plan, Inc. and Kaiser Foundation Hospitals

output.headline: Pays Safe Passages up to $49,999.99 for AmeriCorps and social work support at Esperanza Elementary

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $49,999.99

output.summary: Safe Passages will place 3 AmeriCorps members, 1 VISTA member and 1 Master of Social Work intern at Esperanza Elementary School. They will support early literacy, family engagement and social-emotional needs. The period is November 10, 2021 through June 1, 2022, with payment capped at $49,999.99.

output.headline: Ratifies up to $15,000 for a Historically Black Colleges and Universities college fair

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $15,000.00

output.summary: National College Resources Foundation will run a college fair with 20+ recruiters from Historically Black Colleges and Universities (HBCUs) who can accept students on the spot and waive application fees. Students who attend get free tickets to the 19th Annual Oakland Black College Expo. The period is February 19-26, 2022 and the Board is ratifying the agreement.

output.headline: Moves $10,000 in Fremont High's 2021-22 Measure N budget from equipment to supplies
output.summary: On the Measure N Commission's recommendation, the Board is approving Fremont High School's request to move $10,000 in its 2021-22 Measure N budget from Equipment to Supplies & Materials. The stated reason is a need to allocate funds for supplies.

output.headline: Moves $2,000 in Oakland Tech's 2021-22 Measure N budget from consultants to equipment
output.summary: On the Measure N Commission's recommendation, the Board is approving Oakland Technical High School's request to move $2,000 in its 2021-22 Measure N budget from Consultant Contracts to Equipment. The stated reason is that OUSD will now provide that support itself.

output.headline: Moves $3,584.24 in Oakland Tech's 2021-22 Measure N budget from supplies to equipment
output.summary: On the Measure N Commission's recommendation, the Board is approving Oakland Technical High School's request to move $3,584.24 in its 2021-22 Measure N budget from Supplies & Materials to Equipment. The text says there are no changes to the pathway development.

output.headline: Pays Swun Math up to $205,000 for math lessons and coaching at Community United Elementary

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $205,000.00

output.summary: Swun Math, LLC will provide a math pacing guide, lessons, trimester exams, teaching strategies and monthly coaching visits for teachers and principals at Community United Elementary School. The service period is August 31 through October 31, 2021, which ended before this Board vote. Payment may not exceed $205,000.

output.headline: Adds $1M to RO Health contract for COVID testing support staff, raising the cap to $1.5M

money.evidence: in the additional amount of $1,000,000

output.summary: This amendment adds three more categories of staff from RO Health, Inc. to support COVID testing, arranged through the Programs for Exceptional Children Department. The added amount is $1,000,000, raising the not-to-exceed amount of this 2021-22 nonpublic school and agency services master contract from $500,000 to $1,500,000. The period is July 1, 2021 through June 30, 2022.

output.headline: Sets cost sharing with North Region SELPA for a special education facility at 915-54th Street
output.summary: This memorandum of understanding (MOU) between the district and the North Region Special Education Local Plan Area (SELPA) covers sharing the construction and routine maintenance costs and the use of the building at 915-54th Street, Oakland. The building is used to provide services to students. No dollar amount is stated in the text. The agreement runs July 1, 2022 through June 30, 2027.

vendor.name: North Region Special Education Local Plan Area (SELPA)

output.headline: Ratifies a Measure N commission member's third and final term through January 2024
output.summary: The Board ratifies the Board President's reappointment of a member of the Measure N College and Career Readiness Commission. It is the member's third and final term, running February 1, 2022 through January 31, 2024. The text says the member has rendered satisfactory service to date.
